Admissions & Aid
Admissions & Aid
When you apply to Rutgers Graduate School-Camden, you’re not just making a choice; you’re taking a step toward a brighter tomorrow. Throughout the application process, we’re just a call or email away. And when it’s time to decide, we consider more than just numbers. We consider you and your unique academic and professional journey, as well as how you can contribute to and benefit from our campus community. For entrusting us with your future, we’ll invest in yours by offering a world-class education and generous financial aid packages that acknowledge both your hard work and your potential. We look forward to meeting you.
TAKE THE NEXT STEP
Apply Today

Don’t Put Your Future On Hold
Rutgers-Camden is your gateway to pursuing passions and accelerating careers. We embrace diversity, with students from community colleges to Ivy League institutions, working professionals to retirees, and ages ranging from 26 to 86 and beyond. Whether you’re just around the corner or across the world, don’t wait any longer. Apply today and take the first step towards an enriching graduate education that’s tailored to your unique journey.
ABOUT RUTGERS
Learn More About Rutgers

How to Apply
Navigating the application process can indeed seem overwhelming, but we want you to know that we’re here to guide you through it every step of the way. Our dedicated team specializes in assisting prospective students like you. Whether you’re inquiring about accelerated degree programs, graduate certificates, admission prerequisites, application deadlines, or specific requirements such as English Proficiency or the GRE, rest assured, we’ve got you covered.

Statement of Purpose
In the event that you can’t find the information you need on our program pages, we encourage you to get in touch with us. Connecting with our team ensures you’ll receive swift and comprehensive support tailored to your unique journey. Your educational aspirations are important to us, and we’re excited to help you achieve them.
Apply Today
Financing Your Graduate Education
Embarking on a graduate academic journey is an investment in your future, and at Rutgers University-Camden, we understand the importance of ensuring this path is accessible and financially sustainable. To support our diverse community of scholars, we offer a range of competitive funding options, including scholarships, assistantships, and fellowships. These opportunities, generously provided by the Graduate School, specific departments, and the university as a whole, empower you to achieve your academic and professional goals.
